notes.title: Bug Fixes and QOL Patch
notes.content:
You can now use A to use supers, and lock-in in Couch Party control mode.

Fixed a bug with capture the flag where players wouldn't drop flags properly.
Fixed super available shine not resetting properly when resetting a game.

See you in the Arena!

notes.title: Mobile Device Controls is Live!
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to introduce a brand-new way to play Sunset Arena! Now, all you need is a device to run the game, a WiFi network or hotspot, and up to 8 players can join the fun—no extra controllers required!

Whether you're dueling at a coffee shop, hosting a party at a restaurant, or gaming on the go, Sunset Arena fits perfectly into your plans. It's arcade-level fun in the palm of your hand—literally.

If you find yourself playing somewhere unexpected or exciting, I’d love to hear your stories!

See you in the Arena!
Marshall
[i]Unprecedented Studios[/i]

notes.title: Sunset Arena is RELEASED!
notes.content:
What's new in the release version?

New Soundtrack - Way more synthwave music to set the vibe
New Game Mode - Co-op survival waves
Achievements - Show off to your friends
New Controls - Play with auto aim, or take control with multiple ways to aim 
Visual updates - Improved visibility for small screens
Other improvements and bug fixes!

notes.title: Another New Game Mode!
notes.content: Excited to announce Arena Ball has been brought to the grid!  If you've ever wanted to play Synthwave Soccer, now is your chance!

notes.title: New Game Mode!
notes.content:
I'm pretty excited to say that Capture the Flag game mode has made it's way into Sunset Arena!  This update also includes some bug fixes and boss death animation.  This is one of my personal favorite game modes and I hope you enjoy it too!

Coming soon: 
Arena Ball
More songs for the sound track
New weapons

notes.title: Steam Deck Support
notes.content:
While the game isn't verified, I wanted to state publicly that it is fully Steam Deck Compatible.  I personally play and test on the Steam Deck regularly.  If you find anything that seems to be working improperly on Steam Deck (or Windows) you can email feedback@unprecedentedStudios.com to get it looked at.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Early Access Is Here!
notes.content:
Sunset Arena Early Access is here!  Get the first version of Sunset Arena and become part of the Unprecedented story.  The game currently has Death Match, King of the Hill and a Co-op boss mode.  Both Death Match and King of the Hill also have team variants.  Load up your Steam Deck with the arcade party game meant to turn your Deck into the ultimate mini-arcade.  Bring the  party wherever you go!

You can play up to 8 players and up to 4 teams.  Choose your players color, choose from different weapons and super abilities!

There's never been a better time to provide your thoughts!  Send your feedback to feedback@unprecedentedstudios.com


See you on the grid!
Unprecedented Studios
